question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the
stimulus: sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) Saadi set out for the palace wearing an ordinary dress and stopped at a courtier's house on the way to spend the night. (b) On his way back, Saadi again stopped at the same house but this time he wore a rich dress. (c) The courtier realized his mistake and apologized to him. (d) One day, the emperor invited him to his palace. (e) Instead of eating Saadi started to put the food into his pockets, saying that his dress deserved it. (f) Sheikh Saadi was a great Persian poet who would lead a simple life. (g) The courtier then welcomed him warmly and served him delicious food. (h) The courtier considered him as an ordinary person and did not treat him well. Part B: Writing Test (50 Marks)
